_about: Rules you may change. The deep check (BounceBan) is aimed only at catch-all domains, where the cheap check is guessing.
_check_statuses: Which email_status values get the deep check. Add "unknown" to also deep-check what the cheap check could not answer. That spends more.
_send_score: Deliverable with this score or more = valid (send). Below it = risky.
_max_checks_per_person: The most candidates deep-checked for one person.
_credits_per_check: What one deep check costs on your plan. Check your BounceBan account.
_approval_above: A run that can cost more credits than this waits for a person to approve it.
_max_wait_seconds: How long to wait for one slow deep check before it counts as unknown.
